title: Execute Gaussian Smith circuits and prove sharp precision requirements
body:
PR5815 supplies an informal Gaussian Smith circuit but no executed checker. This package supplies a full arbitrary-input residue interpreter, independent dense/direct-tensor oracles, exact operation and precision invoices, and a paid exact forward/swap/inverse installation fixture. Odd Gaussian precision retains its parity bit; zero normalized precision is distinguished from zero raw modulus.

Two scoped precision results are sharp: the diagonal bank uses exactly the information needed to distinguish every raw output, and one fewer digit in any live T-cut coordinate loses a required output. The proof covers all sizes; the checker constructs **2,746 explicit underprecision input pairs**. This is not a time lower bound or a new kappa.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c137f338117e8a88816ce254efe3b1494809711f/research/gaussian-smith-execution/PROOF.md), [executable API](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c137f338117e8a88816ce254efe3b1494809711f/research/gaussian-smith-execution/engine.py), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c137f338117e8a88816ce254efe3b1494809711f/research/gaussian-smith-execution/RESULT.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c137f338117e8a88816ce254efe3b1494809711f/research/gaussian-smith-execution/VALIDATION.md). The original Smith factorization, schedule and native assembly retain [PR5815](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5815)'s credit.

Verification covers **723 full modular endpoints through1,024 coordinates,63 basis axes,19,773 residue cases,768 whole-pass invoices and seven exhaustive finite-ring image censuses**. Ten exact installation cases include both central kernels, a payload/header swap, alignment and cleanup. Seven source-corruption controls and four semantic control families pass. Normal and optimized registered checks pass with Python3.12.14 and the standard library. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and the official19-file export pass. Sealed read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH passed in1.64seconds, preserving all20 files including its manifest.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-smith-execution
```

The cost record includes ADD, PHASE, PI2_SCALE, TRUNCATE, INIT, COPY and CLEAR. This is an indexed ordinary-array circuit; native matchers, spectator routing, physical tapes and reversible truncation remain separate obligations. At precision proportional to width, its full addition mass remains Theta(2^n*n^2), as the predecessor states. No runtime speedup, supplier admission, complete multiplier or selected-frontier change is claimed; all five framework assumptions remain. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted scientific replay and independent human acceptance are pending.

Base canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority8, refreshed before submission. The connector-alphabet-change card is explicitly changed to this ordinary-response implementation and audit; its945-pairing first control passes. Live handoffs and PR overlap were checked, with cached/sparse/unpublished coverage limits. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19208960). Exact publication head `c137f338117e8a88816ce254efe3b1494809711f`.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Credit Dugongue and all unchanged source notices for the Gaussian construction/native/precision/compiler lineage. The new contribution is execution, independent audit and the scoped sharp information/cut proof. No merge or closure is requested.
